props.lede: Speak with Myles from Ripehouse Advisory about what you want your next investment to achieve, where you are up to, and the questions holding up your decision. We will help identify what needs checking next and whether our property advisory and acquisition service could help you move forward.

props.promiseNote: Myles will call the number you provide at your selected time.

steps.title: Start with your goal
steps.text: What do you want your next investment to achieve? We will start with your priorities, time horizon and current position.

steps.title: Clarify the decision
steps.text: We will identify the main question holding you up and what needs checking, whether that concerns finance, timing, property approach or the support you need.

steps.title: Agree a useful next step
steps.text: If Ripehouse could help, we will explain why and discuss a deeper consultation. Otherwise, we will identify what needs attention before you move forward.

props.heading: Myles *White*
paragraphs: Myles will speak with you about what you want to achieve, where you are up to, and the decision you need help making.
He will explain the parts of Ripehouse's property advisory and acquisition service relevant to your situation, and discuss whether a deeper consultation would be useful.
Your review is a 15-minute phone call. You can bring rough figures, unanswered questions, or simply a clearer idea of what you want your next investment to do.

props.heading: Is this the conversation *you need?*

items.title: Your first investment
items.text: You want to understand how an investment property could fit your goals and what you need to check before proceeding.

items.title: Your next portfolio decision
items.text: You already own property and want the next purchase to support a clearer longer-term direction.

items.title: Your financial starting point
items.text: You have cash or equity available, or are exploring finance, and want to identify the questions to work through with your broker.

items.title: The right support
items.text: You are weighing up doing it yourself or using an adviser, and want to understand the research, service and fees.

props.footnote: This review focuses on property investment. You can attend while you are still checking finance, and you are welcome to keep working with your existing broker.

props.heading: A clear brief. A considered *purchase.*
props.intro: A property needs to earn its place in your plans. Our advisory and acquisition service connects what you want to achieve with the work of assessing and securing a suitable investment.

groups.title: Clarify the brief
groups.text: Bring your objectives, budget, practical constraints and investment criteria into a clear search brief.

groups.title: Assess the opportunity
groups.text: Connect location research with the street, the property, the price and the risks that need checking.

groups.title: Support the acquisition
groups.text: Coordinate the search, due diligence, negotiation and purchase process around the agreed brief.

props.closing: The free review helps us establish whether this service is relevant to your next decision.

props.label: See the approach in practice
props.heading: How a purchase fits a *bigger plan*
props.intro: Explore a client story to see how their objectives shaped the property decisions they made with Ripehouse.
props.footnote: Individual circumstances and outcomes differ. The case study explains the client's experience and the basis of any reported results.

items.question: Will you discuss your paid services?
items.answer: Yes, where they are relevant. We will first understand your situation and what you need help deciding. If there is a useful fit, we will explain our service and may recommend a deeper consultation. You are under no obligation to proceed.

items.question: Is the review free?
items.answer: Yes. The 15-minute Investor Decision Review is free. Our ongoing property advisory and acquisition service is paid, and we will explain the applicable fees before you decide whether to engage us.

items.question: Do I need finance approval first?
items.answer: No. You can attend while you are still exploring your options. Let us know what you have confirmed and what is still an estimate. If finance needs attention first, we will identify the questions to discuss with your broker.

items.question: What should I have ready?
items.answer: Bring the main question you would like help with and a rough sense of your goals and current position. No documents are required for this initial review. It is fine if some figures still need checking.

items.question: Will I receive a property shortlist or a complete plan?
items.answer: The review is an initial conversation to clarify your decision and assess whether our service is a fit. A personalised property search and detailed acquisition work are part of a separate engagement.

items.question: Who calls whom?
items.answer: Myles White will call the number you provide at the time you select. The confirmation email will show the appointment details and calling number. Check the timezone before completing your booking.

items.question: What happens after the review?
items.answer: If a deeper conversation would be useful, we can arrange a consultation to explore our approach, service and your next decision. Sometimes there is a finance question or another step to resolve first. We will agree the next action together.

props.heading: Start with the question that matters to *you.*
props.text: Tell us what you are working towards and what you need help deciding. We will use the review to identify what needs checking next and whether Ripehouse could help.
props.subline: 15 minutes | By phone with Myles | Free | No obligation
